purpose: Form NCLAT-2 is used to file every interlocutory application for stay, direction, condonation of delay, exemption from production of copy of order appealed against, or extension of time prayed for in pending matters.
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Prepare the interlocutory application in Form NCLAT-2.
Comply with the requirements prescribed in that behalf.
File an affidavit supporting the application.
checklist: Requirements prescribed in that behalf complied with
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
